Hi Daniel —

We missed you on the call a few minutes ago. Totally understand — calendars get messy. I wanted to offer three quick ways to reconnect so you can pick what works best: 

1) One-click: grab a new 15‑ or 25‑minute slot on my calendar (Calendly link above).
2) Propose two times: reply with two windows that work and I’ll lock one in for you.
3) Async: if it’s easier, I can send a 6‑minute demo recording + quick sandbox instructions so your team can try it on demand.

If either of the first two options work, Connor (AE) is copied and can jump on the reschedule to help with procurement questions. If you’re still evaluating internally, I can drop the short recording and a 1‑page ROI snapshot.

Also attaching a small screencap from the demo so you have context (screencap.png).

Apologies if the timezones caused confusion — happy to be flexible.

Thanks,
Hannah
